name: overflow-the-barrow-adds-haunt-then-mills-haunt-count
notes: Overflow the Barrow (OiyjVzW7Av): with an empty graveyard it costs 2 less (3 -> 1, one reserve payment). Phantasmagoria (D3rexaXCBo) is seeded in the mastery with 2 haunt counters; the card adds a third, then mills the top X = 3 cards. Top four of the deck: Dungeon Guide, Fluffy Shopkeep, Fairy Whispers (milled), Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card). Pre-fix the generated body milled with a loop of MZMove(myDeck-0), so only ONE card was milled (graveyard 2, deck 16).

rulesClauses: As long as you have no cards in your graveyard, this card costs 2 less to activate.
Put a haunt counter on your Phantasmagoria. Then put the top X cards from your deck into your graveyard, where X is the amount of haunt counters on your Phantasmagoria.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated cardActivatedAbilities["OiyjVzW7Av:0"] milled X cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro: graveyard 2, deck 16 with 3 haunt counters). Overridden in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MillCards().
